---
title: "Methods"
description: "How the penguins were measured, and what we drop before analyzing."
---


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
library(dplyr)
data(penguins)
```
:::


Measurements come from three species at Palmer Station, Antarctica. Each row is one bird: bill
length, bill depth, flipper length, and body mass.

A few birds are missing one or more measurements. We drop those rows before analyzing, so every
figure and table on this site uses the same set of complete cases.


::: {#tbl-complete .cell tbl-cap='Rows kept per species after dropping incomplete measurements.'}

```{.r .cell-code}
penguins |>
  filter(!is.na(bill_len), !is.na(bill_dep), !is.na(body_mass)) |>
  count(species, name = "complete_rows") |>
  knitr::kable()
```

::: {.cell-output-display}


|species   | complete_rows|
|:---------|-------------:|
|Adelie    |           151|
|Chinstrap |            68|
|Gentoo    |           123|
